review_text: Food is awesome, staff is not

I came to Amintiri for a solo lunch, and truly enjoyed the food. my avacado cheese sandwich was so tasty I wished I could have another. the quantity was enough and all the ingredients tasted fresh and rightly cooked. I enjoyed the food, the quiet ambiance and sketching the cafe in the sketchbook. The staff was observed to be polite and helpful.
